name: Neon Midnight
summary: Glowing neon tube line-art with baked halos on a calm near-black floor of glowing roads, pattern districts and water.
description: Every character and prop is a drawing of glowing tubes: a saturated coloured line with a near-white hot core, a soft pre-blurred halo and a near-black tinted glass fill. Light is ranked: the main character carries the brightest halo and a warm floor light, creatures glow a step lower, props lower still, and the floor stays a calm dark board where faint patterns gather in districts, meandering light roads with violet kerbs connect them and reeds fringe the lakes. It reads like a Halloween rave at 23:59: black, electric and crisp, with scanlines, vignette and short chromatic glitches on top.
bestFor: top-down arena action with crowded screens
avoidFor: projects that need material textures (wood, cloth, skin)

difficulty.why: New assets are just closed paths with a few line widths run through one shared glow bake: a new creature is a strong silhouette, 2–3 protrusions and glowing eyes; a new prop is an outline, a dark fill and an offset back edge. The hard part is restraint – too many hues or effects quickly turn the screen into a colourful mess.

technique.resolution: Native display resolution; sprites baked once at 4 px per world unit (K = 4) and drawn scaled; ground chunks of 256 units baked at up to 2.5 px/unit.
technique.summary: Each sprite is drawn twice with the same paths: a 'full' pass (sharp tubes, dark fills) and a 'glow' pass (1.8x fat strokes, glowing fills). The glow pass is blurred once at bake time (blur 2.2 u + 0.6 u) and the sharp pass is stamped on top; the halo strength (glowA) is set per subject class so light has a hierarchy. Per frame a sprite costs one drawImage.
technique.linework: Round caps and joins everywhere. Outer silhouettes 1.15–1.4 world units, limbs 0.95–1.05 u, details 0.3–0.7 u. Every primary line gets a hot core stroke at 36 % width in the line colour mixed 62 % towards white; secondary/detail lines skip the core. Glow strokes are 1.8x the line width (1.2–3x for special cases).
technique.shading: No shading gradients on bodies: shapes are filled with near-black tinted glass (alpha 0.95–0.97, e.g. rgba(32,4,34,.96)); volume comes from a few dim interior lines (facets, ribs, a wavy 'liquid' cap at 42 % alpha) and from radial gradients only on light sources (carved faces, cores).
technique.lighting: Light is emissive only and ranked: main character glowA 1.25 plus an additive warm floor light and a flickering candle glow behind its face; creatures glowA 0.85–1.0; props glowA 0.6–0.85 with only lamp heads, carved faces and cores at full light. Coloured contact pools (dark core + coloured rim) replace shadows. One key light from the upper right: shapes carry a dim cool rim (magenta/indigo) on their lower-left side. Ambient is pitch black; a violet radial vignette darkens the edges.
technique.texture: None on actors. The floor carries faint procedural patterns (grid, hex, halftone dots, circuit traces, water scanlines) that gather in districts and fade out on road shoulders; no evenly scattered dust. The screen gets 1 px scanlines every 3 px.

paletteRules: Black first: at least 60 % of the screen is near-black (#05040d to #1e0416). Colour only exists as light.

Light hierarchy: the main character is the brightest, warmest subject; creatures glow one step lower; props two steps lower with single hot accents (lamp heads, carved faces, cores); floor patterns stay below ~0.35 alpha.

One hue family per subject type: main character = orange/amber/yellow, small creature = magenta/violet, fast creature = cyan, large creature = acid violet + toxic green, collectibles = lime/cyan, props = lavender/pink/teal, water = blue. Never swap them between types.
Every primary line is a pair: saturated colour + its own colour mixed 62 % to white as the core. Never pure white outlines, never dark outlines.
Fills are the line hue darkened to almost black (rgb ≈ 20–32) at alpha 0.95; never fill a body with a saturated colour.
Far-side limbs and back edges use a darker shade of the same hue (#c06a18 behind #ffae35, #a95ccc behind #d77bff, #6a5ad0 behind #c3b5ff).
No browns, greys, beiges or desaturated mid-tones anywhere.

world.summary: A calm near-black floor divided by low-frequency domain-warped noise into four districts plus lakes. Each district has a dark tinted base and its own faint additive pattern that only blooms inside pattern clusters and fades out next to roads. Meandering light roads (the 0.5 iso-line of a slow warped noise) cross the districts, end at lake shores and are lined with lamps. Detail is clustered: a few floor plazas (landmark ring + a designed band of 6–9 glyphs), clustered circuit boards, reeds on a narrow shore fringe.
layers: Base: per-4-unit cell colour blended by softmax (temperature 0.012) of 4 fbm fields; bases violet rgb(8,8,32), teal rgb(3,15,21), magenta rgb(30,4,22), copper rgb(14,9,15), water rgb(2,9,30); brightness x(0.72..1.22) from a slow fbm and x0.7 on road shoulders. Fallback ground #06050f.

Region patterns, masked by region weight x district intensity (0.16–1 from a 240 u fbm) x (1 − 0.8 road nearness), composited with lighter: violet grid (8 u minor at 9 %, 32 u major at 34 %, crosses every 64 u at 60 %), teal hex grid (r 9 u, 24 %, 7.5 % lit cells), magenta halftone dots (6 u, r 0.42–1.67 u, 36 %), copper circuit traces in clusters (26 u cells, 6–56 % chance from a 340 u cluster noise, 27 % lines, pads, vias, chips), water scanlines every 2 u + moonlight glints.

Light roads: marching-squares iso-line of a 780 u warped fbm, skipped inside water; stroked as a 17 u additive violet shoulder at 4.5 %, an 11.6 u kerb in #3a2f86, a 10.4 u surface in #06050d (leaving two 0.6 u kerb lines) and a dim warm centre line (2.4 u at 7 % + 0.5 u at 34 %).

Floor plazas: one per ~360 u cell at 55 %, never near roads or water: a landmark (target rings, clock face at 23:59, carved pumpkin, crescent moon with stars) 18–26 u at 36 %, ringed at r+9..13 u by 6–9 alternating glyphs (2 types per plaza).
Contours: marching squares on region and water fields, each stroked 3 times additively (6 u, 2 u, 1.15 px); region borders at 40 % strength, shores at 95 % plus an inner shore line at 32 %.

characters.summary: Outline drawings made of neon tubes over near-black glass fills. The main character (~18x31 u) has a round carved pumpkin head (15 u wide, orange #ff7a1a, curled stem and leaf), a short flared tunic jacket with zip and hem band in amber #ffae35, a satchel on a strap, two-bone legs with heeled boots and a long two-tail yellow #ffe14a scarf with fringed ends. Creatures: a magenta root-bulb creature on root legs with root arms, a root tail and a violet leaf crown (~22x27 u); a fast translucent cyan wisp with hollow eyes, a rippling tail and reaching claws (~22x30 u); a large faceted acid-violet root golem with a toxic-green hex core and hexagonal fists (~40x55 u). Poses are computed (IK limbs, travelling waves) and baked: main character 8 walk + 8 idle + 3 dash + 1 hurt; small creature 8 + 8 blink; fast creature 8 + 8 blink + 2 glitch; large creature 8.
rules: One dominant outline colour per type (1.15–1.4 u) with a hot near-white core at 36 % width; interior details 0.3–0.7 u without core; round caps and joins.
Silhouette first: big simple closed shapes (pumpkin, bulb, wisp, crystal) with 2–3 characterful features (scarf + satchel, leaf crown + root arms, claws + tail, crown + fists).
Detail hierarchy: calm dark glass bodies, a few medium lines (jacket hem, liquid cap, facets), the small bright details clustered on the face (carved eyes and grin, pupils, core).
Bodies are filled with near-black glass of their own hue (rgba(26,10,3,.96), rgba(32,4,34,.96), rgba(22,6,38,.97); the wisp is translucent rgba(6,26,44,.58)).
Shading with intent: a dim cool rim on the lower left (magenta on the pumpkin, indigo on bulb and golem) opposite the upper-right key light; far limbs one shade darker.
Faces are the brightest point (#ffeafb / #d8feff / gradient #fffbe2→#ffe08a→#ffa526); blink frames swap eyes for thin lines.
Halo strength ranks the cast: main character glowA 1.25, wisp 1.0, golem 0.9, small creature 0.85.
Facing is a mirrored copy; impact flash and chroma split are white/#ff2a7a/#2ae8ff silhouette copies of the sharp pass. Never draw characters with lighter.

props.summary: Scenery sprites drawn with the same tube + dark glass logic, in their own dimmer hues (lavender #c3b5ff, pink #ff4fd8, teal #38f5d6, lamp blue #7fd8ff, shore blue #2a7fd6): gravestones (3 shapes), picket fences (intact / broken), street lamps (crook / twin-arm), carved pumpkins (single / pair), pylons (obelisk with ring / squat beacon), recursive holo trees (3 seeds and sizes), sign posts with icons (3), hologram shrines and shore reeds (3 clusters). Each is baked with a coloured floor pool and a faint glossy reflection, and placed by composition rules.
rules: Closed outline 0.85–1.0 u with hot core, near-black fill rgba(12,8,30,.95), detail lines 0.35–0.6 u without core; props bake at glowA 0.6–0.85 so they never outshine actors.
Fake 3D: an outline copy offset about (1.9, -1.4) u in the dark back colour (#6a5ad0, pylons #9b3a9a) plus short corner links.
Floor pool: baked radial ellipse in the prop hue (y-scale 0.34), e.g. lavender #9d8cff r 12 at 0.22, lamp #ffb84a r 18 at 0.42; reflection = sprite flipped at 25–40 % height fading from 30 %.
Holograms (trees, shrines): 0.55 u gaps punched out every 2.2 u; they breathe 84–100 %; tree trunks carry the strongest line, twigs fade to #23a894.

Composition: lamps (and a few signs) stand 7.5–12 u beside the road centre line; reeds grow only within 9 u of a shore; trees come in groves of 2–4; graves in yards of 3–5 with a fence; other props keep 22 u off the roads.
Light props flicker as rare double blinks (50 % / 78 %) on a per-prop clock; trees sway with a slow 0.7 rad/s shear pivoting on the base.

effects.name: Projectile with light trail
effects.how: Baked trail sprite 24x2.4 u (orange wedge + white inner wedge, blurred 0.9 u and re-stamped sharp) drawn rotated with lighter at 85 %, growing over the first 0.1 s; the seed sprite (#ff9a2e) flips scaleY 0.65–1 to fake spin; 2 launch sparks.

effects.name: Impact (layered)
effects.how: Core: a white four-point star flash 6 u for 90 ms. Shape: white ring 1.5→8 u in 0.15 s (ease-out cubic). Debris: 4 line sparks fanned around the knock-back direction (1 white, 3 in the target colour, 0.15–0.27 s). Residue: 1 rising data bit. The target squashes 15 % and leans with the knock-back (damped, ~250 ms) under a white silhouette flash with magenta/cyan chroma copies 1.6 u apart.

effects.name: De-rez death (350 ms)
effects.how: 0–22 %: white silhouette, squashed 22 % wide. 14–86 %: the sprite is cut into 5 (large: 7) horizontal bands that shear sideways (quadratic ease-in, up to 6 + 0.9r u) and dissolve top-first, alternate bands with magenta/cyan copies. 50–100 %: what remains folds into a hot floor line 2.4r wide that shrinks to a point. Burst: big star flash (12/22 u), 7–20 line fragments with gravity, white sparks, a floor ring 0.6r→3r, 3–8 rising data bits and a lingering scorch ellipse (0.95–1.4 s).

effects.name: Warp-in (450 ms)
effects.how: Three dashed sigil arcs rotate and close in from 2.5r to 1.2r (anticipation), an additive light column rises and fades, then the body builds from the feet up behind a hot 0.7 u scan edge and settles with an 8 % vertical overshoot.

effects.name: Collectible gems
effects.how: Octahedra in 8 rotation frames, translucent front faces, 0.6 u outline with white core, lime #c6ff3a small / cyan #45f4ff large, drawn additively with a baked floor glow; float with a quick rise and slow settle; a rare 4-point glint on the upper facet. Collecting: ring 3→11 u (18 u large), a vertical light streak and 2–6 rising dots.

effects.name: Orbiting lanterns
effects.how: Small carved pumpkin lanterns (#ffb84a, glowA 1.4) hanging from their handle and swinging as a pendulum (±0.14 rad, biased back), with an additive amber trail that follows the real recent path and fades quadratically.

effects.name: After-images, dash and glitch
effects.how: Fast creatures leave 2 after-images at 20 % / 9 %; 4 % of frames swap in a pre-baked glitch frame. A dash shows launch → streak → brake poses with stretch (16 %) then a landing squash, 4 copies whose spacing grows with dash progress, an orange ring 4→24 u, a floor scorch and 8 sparks.

effects.name: Celebration beam
effects.how: Warm star flash, vertical additive beam 18x92 u, amber ring 6→70 u, lime ring 4→46 u, 22 rising sparks and 6 drifting lime data bits.

atmosphere.summary: Pitch-black ambient: all light is emitted. No drop shadows – coloured contact pools and additive floor light under light sources. The glow is baked into every sprite. A cached display overlay adds 1 px scanlines, a violet radial vignette and a magenta-left / cyan-right lens fringe; short horizontal glitches punctuate strong moments.
rules: Contact pools instead of shadows: radial sprite with a dark core fading into a coloured rim, drawn as a 2rw x 0.8rw ellipse; main character orange dark 0.6 / rim 0.26 / rw 14, small creature 0.5 / 0.14, floating creature 0.2 / 0.12 (pulsing with its hover), large creature 0.55 / 0.16; pools fade in during warp-in and out during death.

Light spill: additive radial glows squashed vertically – the main character carries the strongest (#ff8a2a at 40 % ± 4 % flicker, 124x56 u, plus a tight amber core at 18 %); each lantern adds a small 26 % pool; nothing else lights the floor.
Glow is baked once per sprite (blur 2.2 u at 70 % + 0.6 u at 60 % of a 1.8x fat-stroke pass); never shadowBlur or ctx.filter at runtime.
Glossy floor: props carry a coloured floor pool and a 36 % flipped reflection fading from 30 % alpha.
Scanlines: 1 px black lines every 3 px (4 px above 1100 px height) at 12 %.
Vignette: radial from 32 % of the short side to 56 % of the diagonal: rgba(6,0,18,0) → rgba(6,0,18,.3) at 62 % → rgba(2,0,8,.78).
Lens fringe: additive in the outer 9 % of the width, magenta rgba(255,40,200,.10) on the left, cyan rgba(40,220,255,.09) on the right.
Glitch: 3–6 horizontal strips of the frame (4–28 px high) redrawn shifted ±18 px plus a 6 % #ff2a7a additive wash, for 0.12–0.4 s on strong impacts only.
Flicker: neon props double-blink on a per-prop clock (3 % / 2 % of 1/13 s ticks); holograms breathe 84–100 %; the candle glow behind the main character face flickers on two beating sines plus noise.

ui.summary: Thin 1 px neon borders with box-shadow glow, near-black translucent panels, skewed segmented bars with hot gradients, Orbitron numbers with gradient fills and drop-shadow glow, Monoton for big titles, corner-bracket cards on a perspective synthwave grid.

motion: Main character walk: 8 computed poses with contact (0) – down (.125, lowest, body 0.85 u down) – passing (.25) – up (.375, highest) per step; two-bone IK legs (thigh 4.3, shin 4.0 u) with stride ±3.5 u, foot lift 2 u and toe pitch from push-off (−0.55 rad) to heel strike; arms counter-swing ±0.62 rad with elbow bend on the forward swing; head bobs and tilts half a beat late, jacket hem swings late, scarf tails follow a travelling wave (each link 0.95 rad behind the previous). One cycle per 2.4 distance units.

Main character idle: 8 poses over 3.2 s – breathing lifts the shoulders 0.32 u and the head 0.36 u (lagging), a head-tilt fidget peaks at 62 % of the cycle, arms and scarf drift on their own phases; a candle flicker behind the face never repeats exactly.
Dash (0.2 s): launch crouch with 0.46 rad lean (anticipation) → streak (stretch 16 %, scarf streaming) → brake (lean back, scarf whips over the top) with a landing squash.
Hurt: a held recoil pose (lean back, arms up, squinting face) while the flash lasts, 12 % squash and a small knock-back offset.

Small creature: 8 poses, bob 1.3 u, squash 6.5 % on each foot contact and stretch mid-stride, leaf crown lags 1.3 rad behind the body, root arms and tail swing on their own phases; blinks for 110 ms on a per-actor 2.4–4.6 s clock.

Fast creature: 8 poses of a travelling tail wave (ripples 1.5 rad apart), claws reach and retract; it hovers with a quick rise and slow settle (eased, per-actor phase) and squashes slightly at the bottom; blinks like the small creature.

Large creature: 8 poses on a warped phase so each foot hangs and then drops fast; body squashes 4.5 % on impact, fists swing 0.7 rad behind the legs, the leaf crown whips late; a toxic floor ring expands on each footfall (quadratic fade).
Hit: damped squash/stretch exp(−13t)·cos(26t) at 15 % for ~250 ms plus a knock-back lean of up to 0.24 rad; death and warp-in sequences as described under effects.
Ambient: props double-blink, holograms breathe, trees sway slowly (0.7 rad/s), gems float and glint – all slower than the actors.
do: Bake glow once per sprite (blurred fat-stroke pass + sharp pass) and only ever drawImage at runtime.
Rank the light: main character brightest, creatures one step lower, props lower with single hot accents, floor faint.
Give every primary line a near-white hot core at 36 % width and fill bodies with near-black glass of their own hue.
Compute poses (IK limbs, travelling waves for cloth and tails) and bake 8 frames per cycle plus blink variants.
Compose the floor: roads that lead somewhere, lamps along them, reeds on shores, groves and yards, detail in a few plazas.
Use lighter compositing for light only: halos, particles, rings, floor glows, gems.
Layer every effect: star flash → ring or shape → debris → slow residue (bits, scorch).
dont: Don't use shadowBlur or ctx.filter per frame – it destroys performance.
Don't make everything glow equally; a bright ground or bright props flatten the hierarchy.
Don't scatter dust, glyphs or traces evenly over the floor.
Don't draw dark outlines or unfilled wireframes; outlines are always light, bodies always dark glass.
Don't animate with a plain sine on everything – use contact/passing poses, lag and eased hovers.
Don't mix many hues in one effect – a burst is the source's own two colours plus white.
Don't use daylight colours, browns or greys.
Don't draw characters with lighter compositing – crowds would white out.
performance: Init bakes ~70 sprites (main character 20 poses, small creature 16, fast creature 16 + 2 glitch, large creature 8, gems 2x8, projectile, lantern, 22 prop variants) at 4 px/unit with two blur passes each, plus flipped and white/magenta/cyan copies. Ground is baked per 256-unit chunk incrementally (generator with yields); roads reuse the marching-squares contour code on one extra noise field. Per frame: one drawImage per sprite (axis-aligned; a rotated transform only during a hit lean), death bands only for dying actors, particles batched into a few additive strokes by colour/alpha bucket and flushed after the last visible particle, one cached full-screen overlay. Measured against the previous version in the same session: play frame x1.07, chunk build x1.13, dense stage x1.20.
